citation: Zilstorff DB, Richter MM, Hannibal J, et al. Secretion of glucagon, GLP-1 and GIP may be affected by circadian rhythm in healthy males. BMC Endocrine Disorders. 2024.
protocol: 24 h on a hospital ward, 15 h awake / 9 h sleep; after overnight fast, blood every 3 h from 09:00; standardised breakfast 09:30 (846 kcal), lunch 13:00 (636 kcal), dinner 19:00
population: n=24 healthy men, age 26+/-5 y, BMI 22.9+/-1.6, HbA1c 33.7+/-2.2 mmol/mol

reports.where: Table 2 (baseline, mesor, amplitude, peak time) and Table 1

note: Cosinor summaries in the table rather than per-time means; per-time values are in figures. Two subjects were not fasted at the 09:00 sample (n=22 at first time point). Closest paper to a controlled 24 h meals + sleep protocol.
